limitations: Finite probes do not prove absence of every possible shortcut. Source-size/profile domains are finite and justified by the one-step skill, not by a diversity quota.

Actual learner policy, history, task prefix and future generated entity IDs were not supplied. Conditional selection includes all-fresh/source-seen/prefix examples and zero/no-policy branches; per-learner balance is not guaranteed.
Canonical example has no source answer bank. Related basis, row-reduction and true-statement knowledge points are context and prerequisites, outside this generator.
